title: Siting, Design and Selection of Materials for Residential Buildings in Hilly Areas - Guidelines
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard provides guidelines relating to planning and design, as well as selection of building materials for construction of residential buildings in hilly areas. 1.2 These guidelines are applicable to general residential, low rise buildings, built on individual plots of land, eithernon-engineered or marginally engineered structures. However, for industrial and special buildings specific requirements may have to be considered.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
